meta.scope: 407 schools with positive 2024-25 senior enrollment in the existing Massachusetts merged sample; not a verified statewide census
meta.fafsaDefinition: Screened school-level completions / enrolled grade12 students; numerator and denominator are not student-level matched
meta.groupDefinition: Fixed statewide quantile groups of whole-school student low-income share; group 1 has the highest low-income share
meta.meanDefinition: Unweighted arithmetic mean across schools with available outcomes; not a pooled student rate
meta.regressionDefinition: School-level associations. Statewide models use district-clustered standard errors; BPS models use heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors.
limitations: Current merged sample is not a verified census; at least two other senior-enrolling schools were absent from the original merge.
Suppressed, unmatched and screened FAFSA outcomes remain unavailable, never zero. Missingness is concentrated in higher-low-income-share schools.
No BPS schools fall in the lowest-low-income statewide tercile. The four middle-group schools are three exam schools and Boston Arts Academy.
Campus-tract income is exploratory: ACS vintage and geocoding provenance remain unresolved; school location does not identify student residences.
Outcomes refer to different years and populations. Secondary models are exploratory; nominal confidence intervals are not simultaneous intervals.
Associations do not establish that socioeconomic composition or financial-aid information caused the outcomes.
excludedArtifacts: 03_correlations.csv p-values: 39 negative-correlation p-values have a known export error
Generated Stage 08 policy memo excluded; author will provide their own memo
